title: Create a custom path modifier
summary: Deform copied contours and invalidate the modifier when its parameters change.
outcome: A moving wave that preserves the original path and can pause on click.

blocks.text: Keep the original muted path alongside a cyan path whose Y coordinates follow a sine wave. The existing workshop provides the complete editable implementation.

An analytical contour stores one starting point followed by quadratic control/end pairs. Copy each contour before changing its coordinates. Modifying source arrays would make repeated evaluations accumulate deformation.

CustomModifier wraps a contour transformation. Adjust each Y coordinate from its corresponding X coordinate and the current phase. Apply the modifier to one path, leaving the comparison path unchanged. Use [PathModifierBase](/api-modifiers#pathmodifierbase) when you need a reusable class with named parameters or attachment behavior.

A captured phase variable does not automatically change the modifier’s version. Call invalidate after advancing it so the path pipeline reevaluates the chain. Disabled modifiers and a paused phase should preserve the source contour.

items: Freeze phase while retaining the original path.
Remove invalidate and observe the frozen geometry, then restore it.

blocks.text: Check the result: The muted original should remain fixed. If the cyan path accumulates changes, check that the callback copies its input.
Continue with [Write a custom shader](/tutorial-custom-shader). Use the [tutorial index](/tutorials) to choose another project.
